Nia (CS): Quick heads-up: PulseMed kickoff 11:00am PT tomorrow. Account health = watch (trial, low usage, renewal ~42d). They reported long cold-start first-token latency. Need a compact preflight runbook we can send customer + who owns feedback capture.

Omar (Eng): TL;DR plan: delta-prefetch top-7 prompts, continuous batching target 25ms/token, max batch size 12, streaming on with chunk_size=256 and graceful_fallback=chunked. Suggest synthetic warmup 30m prior with 30 concurrent prefill requests to warm KV. Example warmup snippet to share: for i in 1..30 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/pulse-prod/warmup -d '{"prompt":"sample"}' & wait

Sam (SRE): SRE constraints: route timeout 6s, slow-start throttle 100rps first 10m, error budget alert if route_errors > 3% for 3m. Add canary route pulse-prod-canary to flip if p95>900ms.

Ivy (PM): I'll own the customer-facing checklist and feedback capture. Post-call we'll send 3 quick questions (latency ok? quality ok? blockers?) and tag CRM if sentiment negative.

Nia (CS): Can WarmupBot schedule and log first-token latency samples so we can show improvement live? Also confirm KV sizing for private deploy.

WarmupBot: Warmup scheduled by Omar: id=wb-1876543210 run_at=2026-09-10T10:30:00Z concurrency=30 route=pulse-prod. Logs -> /warmups/wb-1876543210 :white_check_mark:

Omar (Eng): For private deploys recommend KV cache 600MB, prefix TTL 10m, quantized model if acceptable. For hosted prefer reserved r4 burst during warmup window.

Sam (SRE): I'll add the alert to SRE runbook and a short pager policy for >5% errors during the call window.

Nia (CS): Action recap: Ivy owns checklist+feedback, Sam adds alerts/pager, Omar schedules warmup and posts final script, Nia will run preflight checklist 20m prior and ping thread when ready.

Ivy (PM): On it, I'll attach the feedback form link post-call and update renewal tracker with sentiment.

Nia (CS): Thanks team 60a, I'll paste the short customer checklist here later today so support can rehearse.
